citations.assessment: Rashi calls Nehorai his teacher with רביה. Preserve this as Rashi’s identification.
Yochanan transmits Nehorai’s teaching about the different misappropriation clauses.
Tosafot specifically treats Yose son of Rabbi Nehorai as a tanna and explains Yochanan’s different view.

The exact Yerushalmi context concerns misappropriation by custodians. Nehorai hears and rejects a view, then Rabbi Ami cites Rabbi Lazar and a baraita of Rabbi Hoshaya. Preserve Heilprin’s inference and note the sequence shown by this witness. The unit does not independently prove the relative chronology.
